phases.title: Fix vitest.config.ts: include pattern, globals, and setupFiles path
phases.notes: Changed include from src/**/*.spec.ts to src/**/*.test.ts, globals from false to true, and setupFiles from ./src/tests/setup.ts to ./tests/setup.ts. All 19 tests now pass.

phases.title: Fix tsconfig.json: change moduleResolution from 'node' to 'bundler' (TS5095)
phases.notes: Changed moduleResolution from 'node' to 'bundler' in src/benchmark-backend/tsconfig.json. All 19 tests pass and build succeeds.

phases.title: Fix src/server.ts: add numeric fallback of 3001 when PORT env var is absent
phases.notes: Changed `Number(process.env.PORT)` to `Number(process.env.PORT) || 3001`. All 19 tests pass and build succeeds.
